rows.label: artificial intelligence
rows.description: field that develops and studies software enabling machines to exhibit intelligent behavior
rows.hook: is the tech behind chatbots and image generators that can write, draw and answer questions

rows.label: attention deficit hyperactivity disorder
rows.hook: is a condition that makes it hard for people to focus or sit still, often diagnosed in childhood

rows.label: Hypertext Transfer Protocol
rows.description: application-layer protocol for transferring web resources
rows.hook: is the set of rules that web browsers and servers use to swap pages, shown at the start of many web addresses

rows.label: deoxyribonucleic acid
rows.description: molecule that encodes the genetic instructions used in the development and functioning of all known living organisms and many viruses
rows.hook: is the twisted double-helix molecule that carries the genetic code of living things

rows.label: magnetic resonance imaging
rows.description: non-destructive technique for imaging internal structures of objects or organisms
rows.hook: is a hospital scan that uses powerful magnets and radio waves to picture the inside of the body

rows.label: virtual private network
rows.description: virtual network extending a single private network across a public network like the Internet, appearing to users as a private network
rows.hook: is a tool that encrypts your connection and masks your location while you browse online

rows.label: non-fungible token
rows.description: unique digital asset recorded on a blockchain that cannot be replicated or exchanged on a like-for-like basis
rows.hook: is a one-of-a-kind digital collectible, such as cartoon apes, whose ownership is recorded on a blockchain

rows.label: unidentified flying object
rows.description: unusual apparent anomaly in the sky that is not readily identifiable
rows.hook: is what a mysterious light or saucer seen in the sky is called when nobody can explain it

rows.label: electrocardiography
rows.description: method to record the electrical activity of the heart through passive electrodes placed over the skin.
rows.hook: is a heart test that traces beats as a wavy line on paper or a screen, using sticky sensors on the chest

rows.label: sport utility vehicle
rows.hook: is a tall, roomy family car with all-wheel drive that has become hugely popular on roads worldwide

rows.label: polyvinyl chloride
rows.description: synthetic plastic polymer - A thermoplastic resin produced by the polymerization of vinyl chloride gas.
rows.hook: is the tough, cheap plastic used for drain pipes and window frames

rows.label: International Standard Book Number
rows.hook: is the thirteen-digit code printed above a barcode on the back of a paperback

rows.label: Jet Propulsion Laboratory
rows.description: research and development center and NASA field center in California, United States
rows.hook: is the California lab that builds and runs robotic Mars rovers and deep-space probes for NASA

rows.label: severe acute respiratory syndrome
rows.hook: is the coronavirus illness that caused a global scare early this century, cousin of COVID-19
